scope: Preserve the current light, dark, or automatic appearance on reinstall.

checks.command: Run tests/test_cli.py, tests/test_installer_wizard.py, tests/test_appearance_sync.py and tests/test_apply_safety.py, including the legacy preference fallback. 175 cases passed in the disposable guest.

Set Dark at 10 a.m., submit the graphical Express Install choices through the full Golden Gate installer and restart Plasma. Inspect the dark Qt palette and the rendered Apple menu. Switch to Light and reinstall using the earlier Express payload. Verify the Apple menu follows the new Light preference.

Select Auto in the graphical wizard after a manual Dark selection. Run the installer, then verify Automatic scheduling and the expected daytime light palette. Run focused CLI reinstalls with explicit Dark, implicit Dark, and native KDE automatic scheduling.

coverage_limits: Shared Tahoe installer code, both wizard editions in focused tests. Full desktop reinstalls were exercised on Golden Gate in a disposable KDE neon Wayland guest. The release changes installer preference selection and keeps the previously reviewed menu design.
